Austria / 47.27°N, 11.40°E

Innsbruck

A city in the mountains, twice host of the Winter Olympics.

Plan a trip to Innsbruck

In short

Innsbruck at a glance.

The capital of Tyrol has the Nordkette range right above its old town and several ski areas within half an hour's drive.

Region
Tyrol, Austria
Airport
Innsbruck (INN), about 15 minutes from the centre
Winter Olympics
1964 and 1976
Best for
Short breaks, city and skiing in one trip

Who is it for?

Guests who want a city and the mountains in the same day: a cable car from the old town to the Nordkette, and a different ski area every day.

When to go?

Winter for skiing in the surrounding areas; summer for hiking and biking straight from town.

How do you get there?

Innsbruck Airport is just outside the city. Munich Airport is about two hours by car, and Innsbruck is a main stop on the train line between Munich and Italy.

Where to stay in Innsbruck.
